note: Story wording for the Freight Fate paper, written by the director thread on 2026-11-22. Task N1 copies this to data/freight-fate-paper-phrases.json in orinks-net. A slot is a word in braces. 'always' lists the slots a story of that kind always has. The renderer may use a variant only when every slot it names is present, and every kind has at least one variant that needs only its 'always' slots. Numbers arrive already formatted (1,412). A kind with 'one' and 'other' picks by its count slot. Do not reword without the director: this is player-facing text.
